impact: PackageSecurityUpdatesInsightRunner counts 'apt list --upgradable' against the cached package index. When apt-get update has been failing - an expired third-party signing key is enough, and that was live in production - the index stops advancing and the insight reports few or no pending security updates. The failure mode is silent and inverted: the server looks healthier the longer apt has been broken.
title: Security-update insight under-reports when the apt index is stale
